source.title: Autosomal dominant osteopetrosis
source.whyItFits: Open review of autosomal dominant osteopetrosis, the adult form most relevant in rheumatology practice, including phenotype, fracture risk, and how treatment differs from infantile disease.

whyItFits: Open review of autosomal dominant osteopetrosis, the adult form most relevant in rheumatology practice, including phenotype, fracture risk, and how treatment differs from infantile disease.
coverageNote: The 2017 osteopetrosis working-group consensus was not free full text. This open review covers adult autosomal-dominant disease and states how infantile recessive disease is treated differently.
rejectedInAppHints: An osteoporosis pharmacologic guideline was the in-app title hit and was rejected.
